hook: Climbing pea plants emit volatiles just before neighbor-driven bursts of circling movement.
summary: Tracking pea shoot tips in 3D while profiling emitted volatiles, the authors saw seven volatile features rise before peak circling speed when a neighbor was present, and not in isolated plants. Neighbors also moved more and grew faster. The link is a timing association, and the authors say causation is not shown.
title: Volatile emission dynamics are temporally associated with neighbor-modulated movement in climbing plants.
